description: Estimates a household's 2026 federal and state income tax return from its 2026 income (wages, Social Security, IRA and 401(k) distributions, pensions, Roth conversions, interest, dividends, capital gains and losses), deductions, withholding and estimated payments, and returns the federal refund or amount owed, the state refund or amount owed, and both together; the main Form 1040 lines (total income, AGI, deduction, taxable income, tax, total tax) and the state's taxable income and tax; and every default assumed, the facts the state engine assumed, and what is not modelled. Computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs, the engines the website's 2026 Return Preview is checked against to the cent. Requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass; without one it returns no figures and names the free web calculator. An estimate, not a filed return and not tax advice.

age.description: The age the filer reaches in 2026 (18-110).

birth_month.description: Filer's birth month, 1-12, optional. With it the 10% early-withdrawal tax applies only to the part of the year before 59 and a half; without it, through the year the filer reaches 59.

capital_gain_distributions.description: Capital gain distributions from funds (Form 1099-DIV box 2a). Default 0.

capital_loss_carryover_long_term.description: Long-term capital loss carried over from 2025, as a positive number. Default 0.

capital_loss_carryover_short_term.description: Short-term capital loss carried over from 2025, as a positive number. Default 0.

charitable_cash.description: Cash gifts to charity in 2026. The engine figures the return with the standard deduction (with the 2026 deduction for non-itemizers' cash gifts) and with the itemized deductions given, and keeps the lower tax. Default 0.

estimated_payments.description: The 2026 federal estimated tax payments, up to four installments in order (April, June, September, January). Default none.

federal_withholding.description: Federal income tax withheld in 2026 from wages, pensions, IRA distributions and Social Security. Default 0, stated in the result.

filing_status.description: 2026 filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

ira_distributions.description: Taxable 2026 IRA, 401(k) and 403(b) distributions (not Roth conversions), the household's total. Default 0.

long_term_gains.description: 2026 net long-term capital gain; negative for a net loss. Default 0.

marketplace_coverage.description: True if the household had Marketplace (ACA) health coverage in 2026: the premium tax credit is not reconciled by this estimate and the result says so.

medical_expenses.description: Itemized deduction input: medical and dental expenses paid in 2026, before the AGI floor. Default 0.

mortgage_interest.description: Itemized deduction input: home mortgage interest paid in 2026. Default 0.

ordinary_dividends.description: Ordinary dividends, Form 1099-DIV box 1a (line 3b), including the qualified part. Default 0.

other_ordinary_income.description: Other ordinary income that is not investment income (Schedule 1). Default 0.

pension.description: Taxable 2026 pension and annuity income, the household's total. Default 0.

pension_type.description: Whether the pension is a private pension or a government (public) pension, for the state's retirement-income rules. Default private, stated in the result when a pension is given.

prior_year_agi.description: 2025 adjusted gross income, used with prior_year_tax: above $150,000 ($75,000 married filing separately) the prior-year safe harbor is 110%.

prior_year_tax.description: Total tax on the 2025 return. With it the underpayment penalty (Form 2210) is figured and subtracted; without it the penalty is not figured, stated in the result.

qualified_dividends.description: The qualified part of ordinary_dividends (box 1b, line 3a), taxed at the capital-gains rates; not more than ordinary_dividends. Default 0.

qualified_overtime.description: Qualified overtime compensation included in the wages: the FLSA overtime premium only (the half in time-and-a-half), deducted on Schedule 1-A (IRC 225, up to $12,500, $25,000 joint, phased out above $150,000 / $300,000 MAGI; none married filing separately). Not more than the wages. Default 0.

qualified_tips.description: Qualified tips included in the wages, deducted on Schedule 1-A (IRC 224, up to $25,000, phased out above $150,000 / $300,000 MAGI; none married filing separately). Not more than the wages. Default 0.

real_estate_tax_paid.description: Itemized deduction input: real estate tax paid in 2026. Default 0.

roth_conversion.description: Taxable amount converted to Roth in 2026, the household's total. Default 0.

short_term_gains.description: 2026 net short-term capital gain; negative for a net loss. Default 0.

social_security.description: Gross 2026 Social Security benefits of the household (Form SSA-1099 box 5); the engine figures the taxable part. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the age the spouse reaches in 2026. Default: the same as age, stated in the result.

spouse_birth_month.description: Joint return only: the spouse's birth month, 1-12, optional.

spouse_ira_distributions.description: spouse_split custom only: the spouse's part of ira_distributions.

spouse_pension.description: spouse_split custom only: the spouse's part of pension.

spouse_roth_conversion.description: spouse_split custom only: the spouse's part of roth_conversion.

spouse_split.description: Joint return only: whose the IRA distributions, pension and Roth conversion are on the state return: even (half each), filer, spouse, or custom (the spouse's own amounts in spouse_ira_distributions, spouse_pension and spouse_roth_conversion, the rest the filer's). Arkansas, Delaware, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, North Dakota, Ohio and Virginia tax a couple by each spouse's own income, so there it can change the state tax; federal tax does not depend on it. Default even, stated in the result.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's 2026 wages. Default 0.

state.description: Two-letter state of residence for all of 2026, or DC. States with no income tax (e.g. TX, FL) return a state tax of 0.

state_estimated_payments.description: State estimated tax paid for 2026, the total. Default 0.

state_local_income_tax_paid.description: Itemized deduction input: state and local income tax paid in 2026 (Schedule A line 5a). Default 0.

state_withholding.description: State income tax withheld in 2026. Default 0.

tax_exempt_interest.description: Tax-exempt (municipal bond) interest (line 2a): not taxed, but counts toward the taxable part of Social Security. Default 0.

wages.description: The filer's 2026 wages (Form W-2 box 1). Default 0.

name: estimate_2026_tax_return
title: Estimate a 2026 federal and state tax return
